apify_dataset_ux: Append-oriented dataset storage with export and resumable pointers; B5 uses JSONL append + checkpoint + JSON/CSV/XLSX export.
implementation_dependency: No TanStack/JSONEditor/Apify runtime dependency is added; benchmarks are behavioral references only.
jsoneditor: Keep editable user state explicit; B5 stores edits in an overlay/audit stream and never mutates append-only source JSONL.
tanstack_table_virtual: Separate row model from virtualization; B5 exposes total_record_count plus partial virtual window rather than materializing 1000+ rows into the preview.
